negative_controls: At each site the maximum direction error must exceed the negative-control threshold for a one-hour Sun clock offset and for an Earth vector from the lunar center with observer parallax removed.
scope: Same nominal site origin and height, UTC schedule, geometric center vectors and lunar mean-Earth coordinate convention. Local ENU for the reference is independently constructed from Horizons station-to-lunar-center and north-pole-to-lunar-center vectors. Different planetary ephemeris generations are retained. All rows and both negative controls must pass.
